title: server(metadata): the publish doors gate the raw stored flow draft, while the live save gates its D2-converted body (#21982), so a legacy spelling the engine registers is refused at publish
body:
domain:server#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQxwoGb5fSnrFkpxmt

立卡门: ① 在飞卡欠的后续。#29233(PR #29526)把流程区域形状判定挪到 #29495 的 lint 注册行后，卡线程实测：发布门判的是存储的原始草稿体，不是转换后的体。席位裁定 A(原样落地 + 本卡)。
业务理由: 同一个流程，保存时判转换后的体(#21982),发布时判原始体，两道门答案不一。旧拼写(D2，例如 get_record 的 `config.filters`)引擎在注册时转换后能接受，但发布门按原始体拒掉。新草稿写不出旧拼写，受影响的只是早先存下的草稿。
动手的读者: domain:server 席。改 `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` 的 `publishMetaItem`(约 L17998)与 `publishPackageDrafts`(约 L19255)的流程判定输入。⛔ protocol.ts 冻结(#25467 E2)期间不动手。
查重: `publish draft converted flow gate raw` 9 命中，均为 QA 跑批卡与席位帖，没有同题卡。

Follow-up of: #29233 (PR #29526), #29049 (PR #29495)

## Measured (card thread, #29233)
- The engine refuses at registration every flow body `FlowSchema` refuses, except legacy D2 spellings: `FlowSchema` refuses them raw, but `applyConversionsToFlow` accepts them, so `canonicalizeFlow` registers them.
- `publishMetaItem` answers 422 and `publishPackageDrafts` fails on such a stored draft. Both carry the issues `expression-invalid` and `flow-region-shape-invalid`, because both doors gate the RAW stored body.
- The save door already judges the converted body and stores the raw one (#21982; `protocol.save-flow-canonicalization.test.ts` "the fallback gate judges the D2-converted body, and stores the raw one").
- NOT MEASURED: whether any legacy spelling is refused by `flow-region-shape-invalid` alone. On the measured spelling `expression-invalid` already refuses it.

## Wanted
- Both publish doors judge a flow the way the save door does: the verdict is on the `applyConversionsToFlow` body; the stored and published bytes stay the raw body. One judge, one spelling, the same answer at save and at publish.
- Reuse the save door's conversion seam (`protocol-flow-save-replay.ts` / the #21982 fallback path), no second converter. ⛔ No skip of any rule, no rule-local carve-out in `packages/lint`.
- Tests: a stored draft in a legacy D2 spelling that the engine registers now publishes through both doors; a draft `FlowSchema` refuses after conversion is still refused with the same issues.
- `Clause-②: no (widening)`: a body that only failed raw now passes. `Metadata-protocol: publish verdict input`. Changeset per the gate.

## Serial
- `protocol.ts` freeze (#25467 E2): start after the lifting note.
- After PR #29495 (#29049) and PR #29526 (#29233) merge.
